# Scientific review

**Correctness — PASS.** The exact rational identity in the quotient algebra generated by the eight-cycle yields every matrix entry with a common positive denominator. Four numerators have nonnegative coefficients. The others factor through four explicitly stated polynomials; their Descartes sign patterns and exact evaluations at zero, one, three and four prove the sole positivity interval and its endpoints. The bundled script reconstructs the identity in integer polynomial arithmetic. Matrix comparisons are separate corroboration, not a replacement for the finite symbolic proof.

**Originality — PASS, with residual risk.** The closest published Markov result proves the eight-state minimum and a different stochasticity window for a reducible absorbing pure-birth chain. The inspected Zappavigna–Colaneri–Kirkland–Shorten example uses a nonconservative upper shift, not the directed cycle with both row and column sums zero. The present complete interval on the *irreducible uniform eight-cycle* does not follow from the stated finite-state minimum or the absorbing-chain window, and no exact prior cyclic formula was located. General absolute-monotonicity theory could conceal a stronger implication not detected in the inspected material; no uniqueness of the literature claim is asserted.

**Value — PASS.** The oriented uniform cycle is the canonical strongly connected, nonsymmetric balanced Markov network. A sharp reentrant positivity window separates preservation of probability mass from preservation of probability *signs*, and yields a reproducible benchmark for positivity of implicit high-order schemes on nonreversible chains. The exact endpoints and all-step sign classification go beyond an isolated counterexample.

**Limitations and closer literature.** The formula is for one eight-state homogeneous cycle; it is not a universal eight-state theorem. It is distinct from the absorbing pure-birth example in the published eight-state barrier and from Zappavigna et al.'s upper-shift construction. A full-source comparison with all specialized cyclic Padé literature remains a publication-level residual risk.

Self-review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
